title: ci(lint): say the ADR index step reds on a dropped header field

Fixes #31261

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`.github/workflows/lint.yml` 里 ADR 索引那一步(`id: adr-index-current-report-only`)的注释块和 `name:`,只改文字。新名字是 `ADR index is current (warnings, except a dropped header field is a red)`。
- 为什么改:PR #31252 之后,`adr-index.mjs --report` 在重新生成会清空已发布索引里的 Date / Supersedes / Superseded-by 单元格时退出 1;旧注释和旧步骤名仍说「这一步永远不会因为记录而变红」,读者会被误导。
- 风险与回滚:不改 `run:`、`id`、`continue-on-error`,步骤行为不变;回滚即还原本 PR。全仓没有任何脚本、pin 或普查读这个步骤名或这段注释。
- 先看:`.github/workflows/lint.yml` 约 687–703 行这一个 hunk。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:adr-index`,预期 self-test 60 条全绿,`--report` 打印 OK 并以 0 退出(行为未变)。
- 需要你做的:受管面 Tier H(`.github/workflows/**`):由你合并或入队,或授权账号 APPROVED 后由席位落地。

## What changes

`.github/workflows/lint.yml`, the ADR index step only:

- The comment block now says what the step does since PR #31252: `--report` warns and exits 0 for a stale index or an unreadable status line, and exits 1 with an error annotation when the regeneration empties a Date, Supersedes or Superseded-by cell the committed index carried (`scripts/adr-index.mjs` `reportExitCode`, `droppedFields`). It also says the index is generated from the records' header lines, not only the status line.
- The step `name:` changes from `ADR index is current (report-only — warnings, never a red on a record)` to `ADR index is current (warnings, except a dropped header field is a red)`.
- No change to `run:`, `id`, or `continue-on-error`.

## Tests

None owed: workflow text only, no behaviour changed, so no test and no ablation.

## Acceptance notes

- **Readers of the name or the id.** `git grep` on `origin/main` 07559ce5a for `never a red on a record`, `ADR index is current` and `adr-index-current-report-only` hits only `.github/workflows/lint.yml` itself. No pin, census or gate reads the step name, so nothing else moves. `scripts/pm/ci-failure.mjs` resolves a step by its name against the workflow source, so it follows the rename.
- **Parsed name.** The new name is a plain scalar with no space-hash pair; `node scripts/check-workflow-step-name-quoting.mjs --list` judges it ok, and a YAML parse of the file gives the step as name above, `id: adr-index-current-report-only`, `continue-on-error: true`, `run: pnpm check:adr-index`.
- **Why a dropped field reds the lane although the step keeps `continue-on-error: true`.** The lane's last step (`scripts/ci/lane-verdict.mjs`) reads each gate step's outcome. The comment does not restate that; the file's header already does.
- **Governed surface.** `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD` on head 2787b0af, exit 3:

```text
governed-surface predicate: 1 of 1 path(s) hit the register (13 surfaces govern objectstack).
  ⛔  GOVERNED — a human merge is the review record for this PR (#9495 regime).
      ⚖️ landing tier: H(人合) — the maintainer's hand, or an authorized APPROVED review (GOVERNED_APPROVERS) and then the owning seat lands it.
      .github/workflows/** ×1 — CI, deploy and release workflows: what runs on every push, what deploys, what gates the queue
        - .github/workflows/lint.yml
  ⚠️  head repo: NOT MEASURED — this verdict cannot tell a fork PR from an internal one; `--pr N` reads it.
  size: 26 changed line(s) (+16 / -10) ≤ 3000 — under the human-merge threshold (generated files included in the count).
```

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: no path-derived model mandate for this surface.

## Verification

Gate union derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (42 families for this diff), run on head `2787b0af`, each exit code captured before any pipe:

- **42 run, exit 0 each.** `--ran`: "42 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 42 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
- Also run, outside the derivation: `pnpm check:adr-index` exit 0 ("self-test 60 assertions green", `--report` OK), and `node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs` exit 0.
- `pnpm lint`: the diff touches no package, so there is no scoped package lint; eslint does not read workflow YAML.
- CI families are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run here.

`skip-changeset`: a workflow file, published by no package.
